source: Approved v14 Pump.fun trucker is the common hat base. User-supplied local PNG files are unchanged lettering references only.

assets.status: Archived source retained unchanged; excluded from inventory, loading and exports
assets.name: BEAR trucker

fitting.method: Recolor approved v14/trucker.png at native dimensions, preserving source alpha and coordinates, then render with unchanged drawTrucker placement, clips and side trims. Omit Pump.fun branding. Extract original BOBO embroidery, scale to 170px height and add a gentle upward arc by vertically shifting columns. No supplied hat geometry, fabric, button, rope or bill is composited.
fitting.preserved: Identical approved panel construction, bill, mesh, seams, source shading and placement. Original Pump.fun rendering and all existing source assets remain unchanged. BEAR is inactive with its original local source retained. No generated replacement artwork is used.
fitting.supersedes: Unapproved straight-lettering BOBO preview; BEAR excluded from release scope
